annotations.title: Find public copies of a code string

description:
Search public repositories for an exact code string; return WHERE it appears.

Use it to hunt vendored / copy-pasted copies of known-vulnerable code: search a
distinctive line or symbol from the vulnerable function, then FETCH AND READ the hits
to judge which copies are still unpatched, reachable, or just fossils/forks. Returns
RAW search results only -- it makes no vulnerability judgment; that reasoning is yours.

Args:
    code:  an exact code string, e.g. "VP8LBuildHuffmanTable" or a distinctive line.
    lang:  language filter for the code search (default "c").
    limit: max hits to return (default 50).
name: search_public_code
title: Find public copies of a code string
